title: BugAnnotation
description: Schema for ground-truth and predicted web UI bug annotations.

url.description: Full URL of the page where the issue occurs.

viewport.description: Viewport configuration for the browser when the issue was observed.

device.description: Device name or profile (e.g., desktop_1080p, iphone_12).

screenshot_path.description: Relative path to the screenshot image file capturing the issue.

description.description: Short natural language description of the issue.

steps_to_reproduce.description: Detailed steps to reproduce the issue (optional).

dom_snapshot_path.description: Relative path to a DOM snapshot file, if available.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the issue was recorded.

run_id.description: Identifier linking this annotation to a specific test run.

page_context.description: Additional context such as form name, component ID, or user role.
